title: SWE-Test: Benchmarking LLM Vulnerability Discovery via Input Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.06229v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vulnerability discovery is becoming an important ability of large language model (LLM) agents: agents that silently miss real defects leave critical software exposed. Rigorously measuring this ability is therefore urgent, but existing benchmarks are gameable through data contamination, score recall against an unknowable vulnerability set, often rely on synthetic bugs, and report a single end-to-end verdict that cannot localize where an agent fails. Vulnerability discovery is a composite ability: an agent must comprehend source code, infer input constraints, construct inputs, execute them, and iteratively correct from feedback. We recast its measurement as an input-prediction task with a closed, deterministic ground truth: using coverage-guided fuzzing, we mine deep target branches in real-world C/C++ programs and ask an agent to predict an input that drives execution to a given branch. translated_title: SWE-Test：通过输入预测对LLM漏洞发现能力进行基准测试
translated_abstract: 漏洞发现正在成为大语言模型（LLM）智能体的一项重要能力：那些默默遗漏真实缺陷的智能体会使关键软件处于暴露风险之中。因此，严格衡量这一能力十分迫切，但现有基准测试存在诸多缺陷：容易因数据污染而“作弊”、针对不可知的漏洞集合来计算召回率、往往依赖人工合成的漏洞，并且只报告单一的端到端判定结果，无法定位智能体在哪个环节失败。漏洞发现是一种复合能力：智能体必须理解源代码、推断输入约束、构造输入、执行输入，并根据反馈迭代修正。我们将漏洞发现的测评重新构造为一个具有封闭、确定性标准答案的输入预测任务：利用覆盖率引导的模糊测试，在真实世界的C/C++程序中挖掘深层目标分支，并要求智能体预测一个能驱动执行到达给定分支的输入。这将漏洞发现分解为三种任务模式……（摘要不完整）
tldr: 该论文提出SWE-Test基准，将LLM漏洞发现能力的测评重构为具有封闭、确定性标准答案的输入预测任务，通过覆盖率引导模糊测试在真实C/C++程序中挖掘深层分支，从而实现抗数据污染、可诊断失败环节的严格评测。
en_tdlr: SWE-Test recasts vulnerability discovery evaluation for LLM agents as an input-prediction task with closed, deterministic ground truths, mined via coverage-guided fuzzing of deep branches in real-world C/C++ programs, enabling rigorous, contamination-resistant, and failure-localizing benchmarking.
